summary: Frontend-only validation of UE grouping in CreatePeriodModal and GradeSheetView for /notes flow on Master Digital Marketing 2026 (1 UE 'UE Principale' / 3 matières: seo, digital, refer). Login → /notes → click formation card → click 'Gérer les notes' → GradeSheetView. All 7 review_request acceptance criteria PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: CreatePeriodModal.tsx: UE grouping via modulesByUE useMemo + selectByUE(ueId) handler is clean. Radix Checkbox state on UE shows 'indeterminate'/'checked'/'unchecked' correctly via data-state on the inner button (not the wrapper data-testid). For automation reliability, consider also exposing aria-checked='mixed' or a data-checked attribute on the wrapper [data-testid=period-ue-checkbox-*] so Playwright can assert state without traversing into Radix internals.

GradeSheetView.tsx (line 440-470): sidebar groups modules by UE via matieresByUE useMemo. Filter by periodModuleIds correctly limits sidebar to selected matières. data-testid coverage is exhaustive (modules-sidebar, ue-grouped-nav, grade-ue-{id}, module-tab-{id}, add-evaluation-btn). Good.
CreatePeriodModal: 'Sélectionnez au moins une matière (ou une UE entière)' validation text is clear and the submit button is correctly disabled until at least one module is checked.
Minor UX: UE block displays counter '{n}/{total}' and badge with UE code ('UE1'). Title 'UE Principale' and the matières list with 'coef X' are visually well-grouped. No design issue.
seed_data_creation: Aucune création persistée: la modale a été ouverte, type 'Examen Final' sélectionné, sélection testée puis annulée via 'Annuler'. Aucune période TEST_* persistée en DB.
